mentions.name: Friendly wake-up call app
mentions.description: This mobile app lets people receive wake-up calls from a friendly person somewhere in the world. Calls are made over VoIP through the app, so no phone number is required. It has a handful of regular users, with the builder making most of the calls themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt: It allows you to get a wake up call from someone friendly, somewhere out there in the world.

evidence.value: It allows you to get a wake up call from someone friendly, somewhere out there in the world.
